text.source: Results: county returns as published by NBC News (from the Associated Press) on Nov 7, 2026, with about 95.8% of the expected vote counted statewide. Counts are unofficial and some counties, such as Alexander and Vermilion, had reported less of their vote. Residents: Census Bureau 2019 county estimates via the JHU CSSE lookup table.
